Lists, watched history, playback and two-way synchronization
CineTrack will sign out of this Simkl account and stop syncing with it. Your library and watch history stay on this device and on Simkl. When you connect again, CineTrack asks how to combine the two.
CineTrack will stop syncing with this Floppy server and forget its address and API key. Nothing is deleted on this device or on the server.
How should this device\'s library and the Simkl account come together?
Titles and watched episodes only on this device are added to Simkl, and Simkl\'s are added here. Nothing is removed on either side; a title on both keeps Simkl\'s status.
This device matches the account: titles that are not on Simkl are removed here, with their watch history.
Choose how to combine this device with Simkl to start syncing.

Simkl signed CineTrack out, for example because access was removed in Simkl\'s Connected Apps or the app went unused for six months. Reconnect to resume syncing. Your library, history and unsent changes stay on this device.
Simkl has upgraded its sign-in. Reconnect once: sign-in opens simkl.com in your browser and CineTrack never sees your password. Your library, history and unsent changes stay on this device.

Floppy at %1$s knows the account you\'re already connected with. If it\'s the same server at a new address, CineTrack keeps the connection: no new initial sync, and pending changes go there. If it\'s a different server, it starts over with a full initial sync.
Simkl syncs both ways. Floppy gets every change you make in CineTrack.
Floppy syncs both ways, with every play at its exact time. Simkl gets every change you make.
Floppy can become the main tracker once its initial sync is ready.
This Floppy server can’t be the main tracker yet. Update Floppy, then reconnect it here.
CineTrack first finishes a full sync with Simkl. Then Floppy becomes the main tracker and Simkl only receives your changes. Floppy’s first sync adds what it has to this device and removes nothing.
CineTrack first finishes a sync with Floppy. Then Simkl becomes the main tracker again and Floppy only receives your changes.
